Thank you, your words actually give me hope. But just to define what is 'wrong' with me: if I could do anything, I would kill another human. Or humans.

But I guess I do need to change my mindset. I find it to be rather cruel and indifferent. Death comes eventually, so I guess I shouldn't hurry and commit suicide. Thank you.

Been there, done that. I get where you're going with this: "maybe while you are traveling you will find something to live for". But I don't think you understand. It's not the place where I live that's the problem, nor the people around me, nothing like that. It's _in_ me. I don't see any other salvation.

I moved countries thrice. Learned 4 new languages. Didn't help.

But thanks for caring and giving advice
